statement: For the 12-vertex rectangular grid G=P_3 square P_4 and induced Abelian Cayley embedding exactly as defined in problem.md, eta(G)=19. Explicitly, f(i,j)=-i-4j modulo 19 embeds G as an induced subgraph of Cay(Z_19,{+-1,+-4}), and no finite Abelian group of order at most 18 admits such an embedding.
contribution: This determines the exact value of the fixed rectangular path-grid cell for which the cited source supplies only an order-20 product construction. The order-19 certificate improves that upper bound, while regular-host arguments and exhaustive exact enumeration over every Abelian group type at orders 13 through 18 prove optimality. This is a candidate full resolution subject to fresh referee verification, not a claim of priority beyond the bounded source comparison in problem.md.
